text: After four years of hard work, we have a new master plan for downtown Toronto: TOcore. It's a plan to build a more liveable and sustainable downtown for the next 25 years. Each of the components of TOcore – the Downtown Secondary Plan and the five Infrastructure Strategies – will help manage and guide growth and development, while ensuring that growth is accompanied by investment in all the necessary community services and facilities that support healthy neighbourhoods, households, and individuals. As we work to implement the strategies detailed in the TOcore plan, including expanding community services and facilities, creating affordable housing, and more, our existing stock of City-owned property becomes increasingly important as our downtown neighbourhoods become more densely populated, and as land becomes more valuable.
